procedure.method: Fresh independent critic turn; no spawn, resume or fork and no peer/producer/planner records read. Read the exact pinned case, packet, rules, rubric, recording addendum/method and adapter; verified all supplied pins. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before viewing posters, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so no source image opens or protected-manifest reads exist. Actually opened and inspected the fifteen exact poster paths with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitted as image items: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same order. All fifteen completed before the first transcription, judgment or score. First-read copy was then recorded independently from those displayed pixels, preserving soft line breaks and meaningful word spaces. One additional actual native opening per member inspected the date/hour ambiguity; both initial readings and that single revisit per entry are retained. No crops, replacements, image edits or OCR were used. Header checks establish all views are RGB PNG without transparency: native 1672x941, usage 720x405 and thumbnail 320x180. For landscape 16:9 the native height deviation is abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5px, qualifying under the declared nearest-integer-single-edge policy, not mathematically exact; use/thumbnail dimensions preserve aspect within integer raster rounding. Runtime session identity is unavailable here and remains null. Actual semantic viewing is this critic's attestation, not a claimed helper-generated open or invented serialized event.
